title: Movies & Animations

process.title: Concept Development
process.description: Initial sketches and concept exploration, working closely with directors to establish the visual direction for the characters and environments.

process.title: 3D Modeling & Sculpting
process.description: Creating detailed 3D models and sculptures using ZBrush and Maya, focusing on anatomical accuracy and creative design elements to bring characters to life.

process.title: Texturing & Shading
process.description: Developing realistic materials and textures using Substance Painter and custom shader networks to achieve the desired visual style for the production.

process.title: Animation & Rigging
process.description: Building skeletal structures and control systems for the characters, enabling smooth and expressive animations that convey personality and emotion.

process.title: Visual Effects Integration
process.description: Creating and integrating particle-based effects, dynamic simulations, and procedural animations to enhance the visual storytelling of key sequences.

process.title: Final Rendering & Compositing
process.description: Optimizing lighting setups and render passes to achieve the highest quality visual output, then combining all elements in the compositing stage for the finished look.
